t: This is the Calvary at St Bartholomew-the-Great, a war memorial. It was designed by Sir Aston Webb, who also designed the principal facade of Buckingham Palace and the main building of the Victoria and Albert Museum. He later became president of the Royal Academy, and was founding chairman of the London Society. The figure work was made by William Silver Frith, a British sculptor. So an architect of national landmarks and a sculptor came together on this memorial.
